__1 N. of Śiva, the second of the three syllables in ओम्; see अ. 
__2 N. of Brahmā. 
__3 The orb of the moon; cf. also उर्गौरीपतिरुः कालः सेतुर्नाथः परायणः । नारदोऽर्कोऽनिलः पाशी मार्कण्डेयोऽथ रावणः ॥ [[Enm.]] -ind. 
__1 As a particle used expletively; उ उमेशः [[Sk.]] 
__2 An interjection of:-- 
___(a) calling; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम [[

.]] or used merely as an expletive. In the Veda used as an enclitic copula implying restriction and emphasis (and, but, on the other hand, now, I ask &c.); in classical literature used chiefly with अथ (अथो), न (नो) and किम् (किमु); see these words. उ--उ or उत on the one hand-on the other hand, partly-partly.

[अवतीति, अव-क्विप् ऊठ्] 
__1 N. of Śiva. 
__2 The moon. 
__3 A protector; cf. ऊः परेतोऽण्डजस्त्वष्टा विवस्वानग्निसारथिः । वह्निर्निशाकरः पूर्णो दरिद्री सरमाधिपः ॥ [[Enm.]] -ind. 
__1 A particle used to introduce a subject. 
__2 An interjection of 
___(a) calling; 
___(b) of compassion; 
___(c) protection.
